findings.source_quote: “Faith is one of the basic ingredients in getting right with God. We come into the Christian life (and receive the forgiveness of sins) through faith. . . We abandon all hope for saving ourselves by our own abilities, and instead, we put complete trust in Jesus Christ for our eternal safety.”

findings.source_quote: This year the spring peepers in our area were “winter peepers” as they feebly squeaked their greetings to the arriving spring in mid-February.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider translating or explaining the colloquial English names “spring peepers” and “winter peepers” into Spanish for clarity (or keep as quoted English but add an explanatory Spanish term). For example: replace with “Los llamados ‘spring peepers’ (ranitas primaverales) de nuestra zona fueron ‘winter peepers’ (ranitas invernales)...” Preserve original HTML and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Este año los "spring peepers" de nuestra zona fueron "winter peepers" mientras chillaban débilmente sus saludos a la primavera que llegaba a mediados de febrero.
